name: encryptSecret
description: Seal a secret (an LLM provider api key) with the OS keystore via NexusSecretCrypt so the guest can persist ONLY the ciphertext ("NEXUSENC1:" + base64) in settings.json. The plaintext crosses the bridge exactly once, on save; every later read on the native side decrypts through the memoized NexusSecretCrypt cache, and the plaintext never travels back to the guest.

inputs.name: plaintext
inputs.description: The secret to seal. An already-sealed value (carrying the NEXUSENC1: marker) is returned unchanged — sealing is idempotent.
